name: Mosquitto
description: Official Eclipse Mosquitto 2.x image (continuously updated, last push 2026-06) with a minimal Unraid template: host networking and a single /config folder. Unlike cmccambridge/mosquitto-Unraid (custom image frozen at 2.0.20 since 2024-11) or spants/mqtt (Mosquitto 1.x, unmaintained since 2020), this template always tracks the official upstream image. MQTT protocol 5, standard /config layout.
